about: The conformance corpus the Node binding is held to. Every case is a MeTTa
source or a wire atom; nothing here records an expected answer, because
the shipped Python host supplies those at run time and a frozen copy of
them could go stale without anything noticing.
Numbers are written as their canonical Prolog text. JSON has one numeric
type and MeTTa has two, so a JSON number could not tell 2 from 2.0, and
the engine does tell them apart: (== 2 2.0) answers False. Each host
reads the text into its own numeric tower, Python into int and float and
Every case must answer the same in a fresh engine and in one that has
already run other work, because the Python host shares one engine per
pytest worker while the Node binding boots its own. A case that turns on
whether a library happens to be loaded compares two different engines: an
!(memoize f) case was here and answered True on one side and the
unreduced expression on the other, depending on which test file ran first.
This file stands in until P4.24's golden corpus lands, at which point the
cases move there and both codecs read one file.

programs.why: an integer past IEEE-754 exact range
a float whose value is integral, the case a JSON number loses
a float with a full mantissa
a float that renders with an exponent
an expression built by the engine
a free variable, whose wire name is a writer artifact
a directive with no answers at all
a program with a definition above its directive
one group per directive, in source order

atoms.why: a symbol that is an operator
an integer one past the exact JavaScript range
a float whose value is integral
negative zero, which a double carries and String(-0) loses
positive infinity, in the spelling the reader takes back
an expression of a symbol and a number
every leaf tag in one expression

refused.why: a rational, which JavaScript has no type for
a number payload that is not a number
a wire atom missing its payload
